title: crm.account.sale-involvements-compensated, payload v1
description: The outcome of involvement compensation (ADR-018 §7). Destination: crm.account.evt.sale-involvements-compensated.v1. SUCCEEDED lets the saga proceed to compensate the products; FAILED takes it to MANUAL_INTERVENTION rather than continuing, because passivating the products while an account still claims them is precisely the inconsistency the ordering exists to avoid. Zero rows removed is a SUCCESS, not a failure: a repeated command must be safe.
